localization_en-US.SGErrorFailed: Your game progress could not be saved due to an error. Most likely, the game does not have sufficient permissions to write to its default output path.
localization_en-US.OptionsLanguageChangedDesc: The game will now reload to perform the language change.
localization_en-US.LGErrorCorrupt: This save game file could not be loaded; most likely its data has been corrupted.
localization_en-US.BuyMenuSearchDesc: Filter nodes available for construction by name or description.
localization_en-US.RecipeSearchDesc: Filter available recipes by name or description.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleBuildMenuDesc: Add new nodes to your kingdom.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleDeconstructDesc: Remove nodes from your kingdom for a partial refund.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleTechDesc: Invest your coin into new nodes, possibilities, and upgrades.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleResourcesDesc: Purchase additional resource input capacity to scale up your kingdom.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleDecorationsDesc: Add colored boxes, labels, and stickers to organize your workflow.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleTechListDesc: Shows tech available for purchase in an ordered list instead of the regular tech tree.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleItemMenuDesc: Shows a list of all items that are available to you, as well as their associated sources and recipes.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleAreaMoveDesc: Select and move any number of nodes simultaneously. Can also be used to mass deconstruct the area.
localization_en-US.ToolbarToggleCloneDesc: Select any number of nodes to copy and paste large areas of your factory.
localization_en-US.ToolbarWarEffortDesc: Inspect the status of the various enemy forces that threaten your kingdom.
localization_en-US.ToolbarForestCrewDesc: Recruit and assign workers to the various tasks available in Byrgenwald Forest south of the city.
localization_en-US.ToolbarFarmDesc: Choose which crops to plant and what animals to raise on your farm, as well as expanding the available area.
localization_en-US.ToolbarDungeonDesc: View all dungeons that your adventurers are able to tackle, and the status of any dungeon parties currently in progress.
localization_en-US.UIRequisitionRerollDesc: Request a new contract from the office manager. This contract will be replaced, even if it is currently in use by another Requisition Office!
localization_en-US.mine_desc: Provides raw metal ores to your kingdom.
localization_en-US.mine_resource_action: #Click# to choose a new material to mine.
localization_en-US.supply_depot_desc: Supplies a variety of raw materials in small quantities.
localization_en-US.supply_depot_resource_action: #Click# to choose a new material to supply.
localization_en-US.unlock_supply_window_desc: Unlocks the #Resources window#, allowing you to purchase additional resource production capacity.
localization_en-US.crafting_action: #Click# to choose a new crafting recipe.
localization_en-US.forge_desc: Smelts raw ore into pure metal bars.
localization_en-US.blacksmith_desc: Crafts a variety of items made primarily of metal.
localization_en-US.shop_desc: Sells most items on the open market for a fair price.
localization_en-US.shop_expansion_desc: Increases gold accumulation limit to #5 gold#.
localization_en-US.collector_desc: Takes in inputs from multiple connected nodes in turn, and combines them into a single output.
localization_en-US.distributor_desc: Takes in a single input, and distributes its items equally to multiple outputs.
localization_en-US.requisition_office_desc: Demands a specific item and converts it into #Requisition# currency.
localization_en-US.requisition_office_tutorial: The Requisition Office requires you to deliver specific items in exchange for Requisition currency.\n\n#Click# to view available Requisition contracts.
localization_en-US.requisition_office_reroll_desc: Allows you to switch out your Requisition contracts in case you want to deliver other items.
localization_en-US.requisition_office_contract_desc: Adds a new Contract slot to your Requisition Office.
localization_en-US.requisition_office_contract_2_desc: Adds another Contract slot to your Requisition Office.
localization_en-US.requisition_office_contract_3_desc: Adds another Contract slot to your Requisition Office.
localization_en-US.requisition_office_contract_4_desc: Adds another Contract slot to your Requisition Office.
localization_en-US.inspector_desc: Allows you to inspect the stats of the last item that passed through this node.
localization_en-US.tailor_desc: Crafts clothing and other cloth goods from a variety of fabrics.
localization_en-US.carpenter_desc: Crafts wooden weapons and intermediate components.
localization_en-US.leatherworker_desc: Crafts leather armor that provides both flexibility and adequate protection.
localization_en-US.incinerator_desc: Destroys any unwanted items that are inserted into its input.
localization_en-US.barracks_desc: Recruits Conscripts in service of the struggle against the many enemies that threaten Yensburg.
localization_en-US.barracks_resource_action: #Click# to choose a type of soldiers to recruit.
localization_en-US.recruit_conscript_desc: Provides a steady supply of Conscripts to fight the enemies of Yensburg.
localization_en-US.outfitter_desc: Equips your combatants with a single piece of equipment crafted in your kingdom.
localization_en-US.war_effort_desc: Send soldiers to fight in the various battles that threaten the safety of Yensburg.
localization_en-US.forest_desc: Hunters, loggers and foragers provide a wide variety of supplies to your kingdom.
localization_en-US.forest_resource_action: #Click# to choose a new material to extract.
localization_en-US.track_switch_desc: Allows you to manually turn parts of your workflow on or off.
localization_en-US.track_switch_2_desc: Adds a second output to the Switch that's active when the lever is in the lower position.
localization_en-US.single_button_desc: Adds a manual control to your workflow. One button click allows one item to pass through.
localization_en-US.timer_node_desc: Allows you to pace your workflow by introducing a minimum waiting time.
localization_en-US.campfire_desc: Provides consistent heat to cook simple meals for your soldiers and adventurers.
localization_en-US.engraver_desc: Enhances the equipment created by your workers by inscribing them with magical runes.
localization_en-US.manifold_desc: Combines up to four I/O pairs for maximum flexibility and throughput, prioritizing from the top.
localization_en-US.stockpile_desc: Buffers up to 10 items to smooth out bumps in supply and demand.
localization_en-US.stockpile_capacity_desc: Stockpile maximum capacity can be adjusted between 1 and 100 items.
localization_en-US.stockpile_overflow_desc: Adds an optional second output that will only receive items when the stockpile is completely full.
localization_en-US.adventurers_guild_desc: Allows you to recruit rookie adventurers, ready for training and questing.
localization_en-US.guild_resource_action: #Click# to choose a type of adventurers to recruit.
localization_en-US.quest_board_desc: Offers a wide variety of Quests for your adventurers to undertake and earn rewards.
localization_en-US.adventure_supplies_desc: A globally renowned company that provides the adventurous customer with basic adventuring goods.
localization_en-US.training_grounds_desc: Increases the quality of your humans, and allows adventurers to train in a specific class when properly equipped.
localization_en-US.training_grounds_food_desc: Entering the Training Grounds with food equipped will consume the food, but reduces energy consumption and training time by #50%#.
localization_en-US.training_grounds_spec_desc: Unlocks #Specialization paths# to allow your adventurers to hone their skills in a particular direction.\n\n#Right-click# an adventurer or conscript in the Training Grounds (or any other supported node) to learn more about available #Specializations#.
localization_en-US.training_grounds_dummy_desc: Adds a second input to the Training Grounds. Creatures created by the Summoning Circle can be inserted here to serve as target practice, #doubling# the effectiveness of the Training Grounds.
localization_en-US.training_grounds_slot_desc: Adds an additional training slot to the Training Grounds.
localization_en-US.training_grounds_slot_2_desc: Adds an additional training slot to the Training Grounds.
localization_en-US.boot_camp_desc: Whenever a Conscript enters the Training Grounds for the first time there is a #10%# chance of immediately gaining a #medal#.
localization_en-US.armory_desc: A storage space for weapons and armor for a small fee. All armories are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
localization_en-US.armory_storage_cost_desc: Reduces the cost of storing items in global storage nodes by #50%#.
localization_en-US.armory_unlock_channels_desc: Unlocks #Channels#, allowing all global storage nodes to store and retrieve items from eight separate containers.
localization_en-US.armory_overflow_desc: Adds a pass-through output to all global storage nodes that are configured as collectors. When connected, items are passed to this output if the storage buffer is full.
localization_en-US.dummy_passthrough_desc: Items that cannot be stored in this node are passed directly from the input into this output (if connected).
localization_en-US.recruit_adventurer_desc: Attract new adventurers from overseas to serve as your specialized fighting force.
localization_en-US.filter_desc: Sorts incoming items by type to disentangle mixed inputs.
localization_en-US.appraiser_desc: Sorts incoming items and humans by their stats and characteristics.
localization_en-US.accountant_desc: Only allows items to pass through if your currency stockpile meets the set requirements.
localization_en-US.inn_desc: Allows your citizens a moment of rest, restoring their health to full over time. Also serves as a minor source of income.
localization_en-US.enchanter_desc: Further improves your equipment by embuing it with powerful enchantments.
localization_en-US.enhance_multiple_desc: Equipment can have one enhancement of each type (Enchanted, Engraved, etc.) instead of just one in total.
localization_en-US.refiner_desc: Improves the Quality of inserted items by up to #10%#. A percentage of items are destroyed in the process, especially at high quality.
localization_en-US.critical_craft_desc: Refiners and most Crafting nodes gain a #1%# chance to double their quality bonus.
localization_en-US.refiner_mana_desc: Refiners now consume mana. In exchange, the refining process is #four times# more likely to succeed.\n\nThis upgrade can be disabled on any individual Refiner.
localization_en-US.refiner_demon_desc: As long as #Mana Sculptor# is enabled, Refiners can now also improve the quality of creatures summoned by the #Summoning Circle#.
localization_en-US.refiner_human_desc: As long as #Mana Sculptor# is enabled, Refiners can improve the training of Conscripts and Adventurers as well. Success chance is #halved# compared to regular items.
localization_en-US.inn_add_food_desc: Adds a second input to the Inn for #Food# items. \n\nAdventurers resting in the Inn will consume food to speed up healing and recover #Energy# based on the quality of the food.
localization_en-US.disenchanter_desc: Manipulates the magical energy of high-quality weapons and armor to extract their #Mana#. Supplied items are destroyed in the process.
localization_en-US.element_stacking_desc: Most Resource and Crafting elements can be stacked up to 5 high, to increase throughput without complicating your workflow. \n\n#Control-click# a supported element to stack a duplicate on top of it.
localization_en-US.war_effort_east_desc: Yensburg once controlled territory to the east up to the fortress city of Bastion. Recently, an army of orcs has invaded and occupied those lands.
localization_en-US.farm_desc: Allows you to cultivate your own food, raise animals, and grow powerful reagents directly from the soil.
localization_en-US.cattle_desc: A large, docile animal that provides both leather and meat.
localization_en-US.butcher_cattle_desc: Turns a whole animal carcass into tasty meat and useful leather.
localization_en-US.farm_soothing_herbs_desc: Allows your farm to produce #Soothing Herbs#.
localization_en-US.butcher_salamander_desc: A special technique to safely extract the boiling-hot meat of a Salamander.
localization_en-US.stalker_desc: A lithe predator that normally lurks high up in the forest canopy.
localization_en-US.butcher_stalker_desc: The animal's meat is stringy and inedible, but its other body parts are highly prized.
localization_en-US.stalker_eye_desc: The blood-red eye of a Stalker. The juices trapped inside contain a strange mixture of potent alchemical reagents.
localization_en-US.beef_desc: A raw slab of red meat, ready for processing.
localization_en-US.hamburger_desc: An exotic delicacy based off an ancient recipe.
localization_en-US.kitchen_desc: Prepares high-quality food for your army, your adventurers, and the wealthy elite of the city.
localization_en-US.pantry_desc: A storage space for food and potions for a small fee. All pantries are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
localization_en-US.pantry_unlock_channels_desc: Unlocks #Pantry Channels#, allowing you to store and retrieve items from eight separate containers.
localization_en-US.restaurant_desc: A place to sell food to the inhabitants of Yensburg. Earn #Crowns# from the Gastronomer's Union for selling high-quality food.
localization_en-US.butcher_desc: Magically transforms the animals from your farm into delicious meat and useful leather.
localization_en-US.luxury_shop_desc: Allows you to sell high-quality items at a premium rate. Also serves as a secondary source of #Crowns#.
localization_en-US.portal_desc: Enables instantaneous transport of items over long distances and between workspaces. Consumes a small amount of #Mana#.
localization_en-US.portal_cost_reduce_desc: Reduces mana cost of teleporting items by #50%#.
localization_en-US.portal_cost_reduce_2_desc: Reduces mana cost of teleporting items by an additional #50%#.
localization_en-US.portal_unlock_channels_desc: Unlocks #Portal Indexes#, giving each Portal channel an additional eight sub-channels.
localization_en-US.portal_overflow_desc: Adds a pass-through output to Portals that are configured as collectors. When connected, items are passed to this output if the portal storage buffer is full.
localization_en-US.add_diagrams_desc: Adds the ability to create and swap between multiple workspaces. Items can be transferred between workspaces using #Armory#-type nodes.
localization_en-US.adv_to_war_desc: Adventurers can now be sent to the #War Effort#. Combat effectiveness is reduced by up to #50%# based on energy levels.
localization_en-US.dungeon_desc: Send a party of five adventurers down into the depths to defeat evil and recover valuable loot.
localization_en-US.dungeon_unlock: Requires war progress: Ruins of Arlingen
localization_en-US.guildhouse_desc: A place for your adventurers to catch their breath. All guildhouses are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
localization_en-US.guildhouse_unlock_channels_desc: Unlocks #Guildhouse Channels#, allowing you to store and retrieve adventurers from eight separate containers.
localization_en-US.guildhouse_conscripts_desc: The Guildhouse can now also be used to house non-adventurer humans.
localization_en-US.jeweler_desc: Creates finely crafted rings and amulets imbued with magical energy.
localization_en-US.summoning_circle_desc: Summons forth extraplanar creatures to fight in your wars and serve as training fodder for your adventurers.
localization_en-US.mercenary_guild_desc: Export the services of your adventurers by selling their contracts to a foreign mercenary company.
localization_en-US.mercenary_conscripts_desc: Enables the export of conscripts and soldiers at the Mercenary Guild.
localization_en-US.alchemist_desc: Prepares a wide variety of potions to support your adventurers in combat.
localization_en-US.arena_desc: Organize fights of man versus man or man versus monster. Earn big money for spectacular battles and train your adventurers at the same time.
localization_en-US.arena_automation_desc: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your Arenas.\n\nUnlocks the #Worker# upgrade to automatically start arena fights.
localization_en-US.arena_blood_sport_desc: Unlocks the #Blood Sport# upgrade: Combatants fight until only one is left standing. Training received is increased massively, especially in human-versus-human fights, and spectators pay more for a bloody finale.
localization_en-US.arena_blood_sport_2_desc: Combatants fight until only one is left standing. \n\n#Training# received is increased massively, especially in human-versus-human fights, and spectators pay more for a bloody finale.
localization_en-US.arena_cashier_desc: Unlocks a new #Upgrade# for your Arena.\n\nIncreases gold income from arena fights by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.arena_cashier_desc_2: Increases income from arena fights by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.war_effort_yensburg_desc: A hidden force has struck at the heart of Yensburg. Some districts have fallen under enemy control, and the tunnels beneath the city are crawling with demonic foes.
localization_en-US.dungeon_feral_den_desc: A natural cave formation buried deep within the Byrgenwald Forest. Some mysterious force inside twists the forest animals into monstrous abominations.
localization_en-US.dungeon_temple_desc: Ages ago, a profane ritual was carried out here to imprison an ancient evil. Now, sinister forces are working to undo the ritual's magic.
localization_en-US.inventor_desc: The kingdom's Chief High Artificer is renowned for creating exciting new technology (side effects not guaranteed).
localization_en-US.scribe_desc: Writes a variety of books and scrolls imbued with magical energy or spiritual significance.
localization_en-US.library_desc: A safe repository for your valuable scrolls and tomes. All libraries are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
localization_en-US.currency_exchange_desc: Allows you to exchange one currency for another, for a price.\n\n#Click# a currency in the top bar to start a transaction.
localization_en-US.treasury_desc: A place to safely store expensive jewelry and inventions for a small fee. All treasuries are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
localization_en-US.hoard_desc: A place to store loot collected from dungeons and quests. No storage fee. All hoards are linked and contents can be accessed from anywhere.
localization_en-US.shrine_desc: Serves as a place of worship for your Clerics. Their devotion can be converted into powerful blessings.
localization_en-US.shrine_unlock: Requires war progress: Cathedral of Saint Ilonia
localization_en-US.graveyard_desc: Allows you to collect the remains of those who died fighting in your wars, and give them their eternal rest.
localization_en-US.fallen_heroes_desc: Adds a new output to all War Effort nodes. Here, the remains of slain combatants are available to be transferred to a Graveyard (but will not block the War Effort if left unconnected).
localization_en-US.necromancer_desc: A shady figure who will "appropriate" corpses from a conveniently situated graveyard for their sinister experiments.
localization_en-US.dungeon_catacombs_desc: The labyrinthine tunnels beneath Yensburg Castle are still crawling with demonic entities. Send your adventurers down to clear them out and discover their origin.
localization_en-US.dungeon_catacombs_blocked: Retake the Castle District to continue.
localization_en-US.war_effort_north_desc: Ironcrag has been revealed as our enemy's stronghold. Lay siege to the mountain and clear a path for your adventurers to enter.
localization_en-US.war_north_blocked: Relieve the Siege of Yensburg to continue.
localization_en-US.dungeon_archive_desc: An ancient lich lord has been building an archive of human history in this hidden mountain fortress for centuries. Break through the defenses, slay the mad Archivist, and recover powerful items to aid in your battle.
localization_en-US.dungeon_archive_unlock: Requires war progress: The Old Guildhouse
localization_en-US.dungeon_archive_blocked: Retake the Old Guildhouse to continue.
localization_en-US.dungeon_endgame_desc: Deep beneath the mountain, an ancient evil waits dreaming.
localization_en-US.dungeon_endgame_blocked: Retake the Pinnacle Ruins to continue.
localization_en-US.iron_ore_desc: Raw iron ore, straight from the ground, ready to be refined.
localization_en-US.iron_ingot_desc: Refined iron, forged into a shape that most other crafters know how to handle.
localization_en-US.iron_armor_desc: Heavy and not very comfortable to wear, but provides sufficient protection at low cost.
localization_en-US.iron_helm_desc: Wearing this for any length of time will make even the most stoic man pray for cloth padding.
localization_en-US.iron_sword_desc: A simple iron sword, suitable for any initiate knight or rookie adventurer.
localization_en-US.iron_dagger_desc: A simple iron dagger, for anyone wishing to train in the more subtle forms of combat.
localization_en-US.wood_plank_desc: Freshly sawn from a softwood log, ready for further processing.
localization_en-US.linen_cloth_desc: Coarse and crude, but provides protection from the elements.
localization_en-US.rough_leather_desc: Processed skin of a dead animal with surprisingly many use cases.
localization_en-US.linen_padding_desc: Provides additional comfort when used in the production of heavier armor.
localization_en-US.rough_string_desc: Leather strips stretched into long fibers, ready to use in other crafting processes.
localization_en-US.simple_robe_desc: The robes provide no magical benefits, but an initiate wizard wouldn't want to be caught without one.
localization_en-US.initiate_hat_desc: Often given to young wizards during their training at the school of magic.
localization_en-US.rough_vest_desc: The durable leather hide, while low quality, provides adequate protection in combat.
localization_en-US.rough_leather_hat_desc: The itchy leather and coarse stitching will make any wearer go mad over time.
localization_en-US.softwood_bow_desc: The materials used in this bow's construction aren't ideal, but it will do in a pinch.
localization_en-US.sapphire_desc: An uncut blue gemstone, famed for both its beauty and its strong connection to magic.
localization_en-US.initiate_staff_desc: Initiate wizards are given a staff during their training, adding their own magic over time.
localization_en-US.softwood_warstaff_desc: The wood is likely to fracture upon impact, making the iron reinforcements a necessity.
localization_en-US.simple_wooden_shield_desc: Will stop a sword hit or two before splitering into kindling for the night's campfire.

localization_en-US.ring_of_health_desc: A pristine ring adorned with a robust ruby.
localization_en-US.ring_of_armor_desc: A fortified ring adorned with three small sapphires.
localization_en-US.ring_of_strength_2_desc: The unblinking eye that adorns this ring stares back at the wearer incessantly.
localization_en-US.ring_of_dexterity_2_desc: The living metal slithers around the wearer's finger as it sucks their blood for sustenance.
localization_en-US.ring_of_magic_2_desc: The elemental magic contained in this ring is constantly attempting to break free.
localization_en-US.ring_of_wisdom_2_desc: The ring constantly sheds tiny seeds that drift off on the wind and sprout alien flowers in the countryside.
localization_en-US.ring_of_health_2_desc: The hungry ring slowly binds itself to the wearer's soul until the two are inseperable.
localization_en-US.ring_of_armor_2_desc: The ring's magic slowly burrows into the wearer's skin, weaving impenetrable fibers into their very being.

localization_en-US.ancient_wood_plank_desc: Sawn from a titanic tree, ready to be processed into a variety of resilient wooden components.
localization_en-US.supple_leather_desc: The hide of a great lithe stalker, suitable for creating armor that requires both toughness and flexibility.
localization_en-US.fortified_leather_desc: Strands of mana are woven through the surface, creating esoteric patterns that subtly shift over time.
localization_en-US.crystal_mana_desc: Pure magical energy distilled into a form that can be used by crafters other than enchanters.
localization_en-US.ancient_woodcutter_desc: A sawblade imbued with magical fortitude, designed to cut even the most resilient logs.
localization_en-US.arcanium_helm_desc: A helmet fit for a champion.
localization_en-US.arcanium_armor_desc: If you're going into battle, you might as well do it in style.
localization_en-US.arcanium_sword_desc: The magical properties of this sword cause its edge to always stay razor-sharp.
localization_en-US.arcanium_dagger_desc: Its thin blade easily passes through even the sturdiest armor without snapping.
localization_en-US.arcanium_greatsword_desc: The blade appears clumsy and cumbersome, but is surprisingly versatile in combat.
localization_en-US.arcanium_battleaxe_desc: For the mighty warrior that wants to fell trees and foes at the same time.
localization_en-US.supple_string_desc: A flexible, braided leather cord that somehow seems almost unbreakable.
localization_en-US.ancient_wood_staff_desc: Tough and unyielding, but its delicate carved patterns suggest a hidden purpose beyond raw strength.
localization_en-US.ancient_int_staff_desc: A solid wood staff adorned with fragmented mana crystals and delicate gold detailing.
localization_en-US.ancient_wis_staff_desc: A runecarved staff of ancient design, carried by sages and soothsayers for generations.
localization_en-US.ancient_wood_bow_desc: The flexible-yet-sturdy limbs of this bow allow for both exceptional accuracy and astonishing rapid fire.
localization_en-US.ancient_shield_desc: An impenetrable shield to protect the innocent and smite the villainous.
localization_en-US.flax_desc: A decent source of clothing fibers, favored for the simple conditions in which it grows.

localization_en-US.cotton_cloth_desc: A fine woven sheet of cotton fiber, ready to be processed into clothing.
localization_en-US.embroidered_cotton_desc: Patterned with arcane symbols and suitable for the creation of powerful equipment.
localization_en-US.enchanted_cotton_thread_desc: The magic woven into this thread prevent it from breaking even under severe strain.
localization_en-US.embossed_leather_desc: Patterned with arcane symbols and suitable for the creation of powerful equipment.
localization_en-US.cotton_robe_desc: A robe worn by seasoned mages and clerics. The delicate symbols woven into the fabric enhance the wearer's magic.
localization_en-US.cotton_hat_desc: The mark of a true intellectual, and a symbol of authority in wizarding cliques.
localization_en-US.embossed_vest_desc: The innate enchantments on this vest serve to increase the wearer's freedom of movement.
localization_en-US.embossed_hat_desc: Serves to obscure the wearer's identity and improve their lethality at the same time.
localization_en-US.iron_rapier_desc: A nimble blade designed for dueling. Its decorative bone crossguard is reinforced to protect the wielder's hand.
localization_en-US.human_remains_desc: The remains of someone who died in battle protecting your kingdom.

localization_en-US.enchant_armor_armor_desc: Enchants any piece of Head or Chest armor to provide additional armor.
localization_en-US.salamander_desc: A strange, lizard-like creature that feels most at home in scalding hot environments.
localization_en-US.salamander_haunch_desc: The flesh of a Salamander, partly cooked by the creature's innate heat.
localization_en-US.onion_desc: An easy-growing vegetable that enhances almost any savory dish.
localization_en-US.wild_onion_desc: A rebellious plant that somehow resists all attempts at domestication.
localization_en-US.stalker_stew_desc: Deliciously oniony. Just don't ask about the other ingredient.
localization_en-US.enchant_armor_strength_skill_crit_desc: Enchants any piece of Head or Chest armor to increase success chance on any #Strength checks# in combat. Also provides a small amount of Strength.
localization_en-US.strength_skill_crit_desc: Strength skill checks are more likely to succeed.
localization_en-US.dexterity_skill_crit_desc: Dexterity skill checks are more likely to succeed.
localization_en-US.magic_skill_crit_desc: Magic skill checks are more likely to succeed.
localization_en-US.wisdom_skill_crit_desc: Wisdom skill checks are more likely to succeed.
localization_en-US.annihilate_gemstone_desc: Destroys the physical structure of an ancient gem, releasing the latent magic within.
localization_en-US.attuned_catalyst_desc: An alchemical reagent used in a wide variety of arcane processes.
localization_en-US.transmute_metals_desc: Employs a secret alchemical catalyst to transmute common iron into precious metals.
localization_en-US.symbiote_reagent_desc: A magical remnant of a long-forgotten civilization, not quite living but certainly not dead.
localization_en-US.symbiote_breeding_desc: Breeds more Symbionts by exposing them to the corrupting essence of darkness.
localization_en-US.dark_essence_desc: An incomprehensibly tiny fragment of an ancient evil. Just being in its presence evokes dread in most people.
localization_en-US.amulet_of_fire_prot_desc: Envelops the wearer and their allies in a protective shroud that wards off fire and extreme heat.
localization_en-US.amulet_of_fire_prot_trait: Grants #{0}# Fire Resistance to all allies.
localization_en-US.amulet_of_shadow_prot_desc: Projects an aura of death and hopelessness in an attempt to protect the wearer and their allies from dark magic.
localization_en-US.amulet_of_shadow_prot_trait: Grants #{0}# Shadow Resistance to all allies.
localization_en-US.amulet_of_poison_prot_desc: Creates a detoxifying aura that protects the wearer and their allies from even the most vile poisons.
localization_en-US.amulet_of_poison_prot_trait: Grants #{0}# Poison Resistance to all allies.
localization_en-US.lifebloom_amulet_desc: Exudes a gentle soothing aura that intermittently heals the wearer's allies for a small amount.
localization_en-US.lifebloom_amulet_trait_desc: Heals all allies for #{0}# health per second.
localization_en-US.fireball_amulet_desc: The tiny beads on this necklace are, in fact, dangerous weapons: They spontaneously combust after being thrown.
localization_en-US.fireball_amulet_trait: Intermittently deals #{0}# damage to enemies in combat.
localization_en-US.stats_amulet_desc: A talisman normally awarded to exceptionally gifted adventurers after a lifetime of service to the guild.
localization_en-US.armor_potion_desc: A disgustingly bitter potion. Shortly after consumption, the drinker feels impervious to harm.
localization_en-US.greater_healing_potion_desc: A brilliant red potion that can instantly restore grievous wounds.
localization_en-US.stats_potion_desc: After drinking this concoction the user feels ever so slightly more proficient at anything they do.
localization_en-US.poison_resist_potion_desc: A sickly-green potion. Drinking it makes you gag at first, before that nagging headache miraculously disappears.
localization_en-US.swiftness_potion_desc: A highly concentrated emerald liquid. It hones the drinker's quick wit and reflexes, making rapid actions easier to execute.
localization_en-US.regen_potion_desc: The thick liquid burns on the way down, in a pleasant way. The drinker feels continuously reinvigorated, an effect that can last for days.
localization_en-US.tinkersteel_desc: A wondrous innovation in magical technology.
localization_en-US.witchcloth_desc: A stupendous advancement in magical technology.
localization_en-US.primal_leather_desc: An innovative tradition in magical technology.
localization_en-US.petrified_wood_desc: A revolutionary new way to incorporate cutting edge mago-tech into traditional craftsmanship.
localization_en-US.tinkersteel_helm_desc: The continuous clicking of tiny gears slowly drives the wearer insane, but also serves to keep them focused.
localization_en-US.tinkersteel_armor_desc: The mago-tech folded into this armor serve to deflect blows and dampen impacts.
localization_en-US.demonsteel_helm_desc: The incessant clicking of gears has been replaced with maddening whispers.
localization_en-US.demonsteel_armor_desc: Blood drips continuously from tiny holes in the armor's surface with no indication of where it's coming from.
localization_en-US.primal_mask_desc: Donning this mask for a prolonged period of time slowly drives the wearer mad with bloodlust.
localization_en-US.primal_cover_desc: The shimmering surface of this armor serves to obscure the wearer's movements.
localization_en-US.hellish_mask_desc: The mask slowly grows over the wearer's face, replacing their human features with a horrifying demonic visage.
localization_en-US.hellish_cover_desc: Tiny needles hook into the wearer's flesh, causing immense discomfort but somehow also making almost any movement more graceful and deadly.
localization_en-US.witch_hood_desc: The living cloth whispers impossible promises and mad prophecies to the wearer.
localization_en-US.witch_robe_desc: An unworthy wearer will slowly have their soul siphoned away by the living fabric until nothing is left.
localization_en-US.prophet_hood_desc: The wearer is tormented by myriad voices screaming blasphemous prophecies into their ears.
localization_en-US.prophet_robe_desc: A beguiling aura draws the attention of allies and foes alike, turning even the most hardened skeptic into a devout follower.
localization_en-US.archmage_hat_desc: The kind of headwear that draws attention at a conference of mages. Subtle thought manipulation makes the wearer more adept at magic.
localization_en-US.archmage_robe_desc: Stylish and gaudy, this magnificent robe is sure to awe anyone that sees you wearing it. No harm ever came from trying on some clothes, right?
localization_en-US.tinkersteel_greatsword_desc: Even though the edge doesn't seem to be particularly sharp, it still slices through almost anything with ease.
localization_en-US.flenser_greatsword_desc: A blade from the deepest pits of hell. It subtly encourages the wielder to commit horrible atrocities.
localization_en-US.tinkersteel_dagger_desc: A nimble, telescopic blade. The blade extends after puncturing the target, causing extensive internal damage.
localization_en-US.blighted_dagger_desc: A system of hollow tubes constantly delivers a deadly mixture of flesh-devouring toxins to the tip of the blade.
localization_en-US.tinkersteel_axe_desc: The weapon's mass appears to increase significantly before impact, inflicting both slashing and bludgeoning mayhem.
localization_en-US.unblinking_axe_desc: The malignant growth overtaking this axe has manifested as a giant, unblinking eye, staring at its enemies with unrestrained fury.
localization_en-US.tinkersteel_rapier_desc: The impossibly light blade darts through the air as if it's teleporting, slicing through its victims without slowing down.
localization_en-US.blink_rapier_desc: The thin blade of this sword is only connected to the hilt in some unseen dimension, allowing the point to bypass armor with ease.
localization_en-US.tinkersteel_sword_desc: The sword will sometimes abruptly change direction in combat to strike from an unexpected angle.
localization_en-US.vanquisher_sword_desc: Dark matter particles drift off its edge and embed themselves into the wounds of its victims, inflicting more suffering over time.
localization_en-US.trueshot_bow_desc: Fired arrows correct themselves in midair to pierce the enemy's weakspots every single time.
localization_en-US.deadeye_bow_desc: Demonic flesh bursts forth and covers the shooter's hand, correcting their aim and infecting their arrows with hellish rot.
localization_en-US.petrified_shield_desc: An impenetrable bulwark safeguarding the wielder and their allies.
localization_en-US.infected_shield_desc: The demonic creature trapped inside the shield threatens to curse anyone that dares to strike it.
localization_en-US.archmage_staff_desc: A high-ranking mage's beacon of authority, as well as the main source of their power.
localization_en-US.fragment_staff_desc: Unable to contain its frightening power, the staff fractured into shards that are still bound together by some unseen force.
localization_en-US.archbishop_staff_desc: An honorable weapon of the high clergy. Its overwhelming presence demands both reverence and obedience.
localization_en-US.unlife_staff_desc: A mockery of the natural world. Demonic vines shoot out to entrap the wielder's foes, forcing them to bow in submission.
localization_en-US.demonic_writings_desc: Blasphemous words scribbled on charred parchment. Nobody understands the language, yet the intent is clear.
localization_en-US.heretic_tech_desc: Past generations believed themselves to be masters of the arcane, treating with demons in order to subjugate their magic. How foolish they were.
localization_en-US.purified_tech_desc: The clerics at the Cathedral of Saint Ilonia swear that the heretical influence has been purged from this powerful arcane technology.
localization_en-US.primal_string_desc: A flexible ribbon cut from a single piece of treated animal hide.
localization_en-US.blank_vellum_desc: A traditional writing surface made from the skin of certain animals. Its inherent magical qualities make it very useful for writing prepared spells and arcane treatises.
localization_en-US.blank_tome_desc: Pristine blank pages, ready to be filled with arcane incantations or prophetic writings.
localization_en-US.mad_scribblings_desc: In a flash of deranged genius, one of your Mages can sketch out the designs for a novel mago-tech contraption.
localization_en-US.decoded_writings_desc: After many attempts, the infernal runes have been translated into a form that mortal humans can comprehend.
localization_en-US.winged_boots_desc: A wondrous invention that allows the wearer to fly over short distances, making feats of dexterity more manageable.
localization_en-US.golem_gauntlets_desc: Enhances the wearer's natural strength, allowing them to lift heavy boulders with ease.
localization_en-US.mind_goggles_desc: Allows the wearer to detect and identify subtle magical influences embedded in the environment.
localization_en-US.crit_goggles_desc: Automatically highlights the target's weakspots for the wearer.\n\nA character can only benefit from a single source of Critical Hit.
localization_en-US.chainsaw_desc: A wondrous invention driven by a mago-tech engine. Its sharp teeth cut into anything it comes into contact with, so be careful what you point it at.
localization_en-US.shield_arm_desc: A clockwork arm that straps to the wearer's back, holding a small round shield. Its rudimentary mago-tech brain predicts and blocks incoming enemy attacks.
localization_en-US.triune_shield_desc: A portable anti-magic shield that protects the wearer from Fire, Shadow and Poison damage all at the same time.
localization_en-US.enchanted_ink_desc: Jet-black ink imbued with powerful magical energy, suitable for writing spell scrolls and arcane tomes.
localization_en-US.scroll_of_healing_desc: The scroll's magic is consumed upon use to restore a large amount of health.
localization_en-US.scroll_of_aoe_healing_desc: The scroll's magic is consumed upon use to restore a small amount of health to all party members.
localization_en-US.scroll_of_aoe_healing_effect: Restores #{0}# health to all party members when health drops low.
localization_en-US.scroll_of_damage_desc: This scroll's magic can be repeatedly evoked to deal heavy damage to powerful foes.
localization_en-US.scroll_of_damage_effect: Deals heavy damage to each dungeon boss at the start of combat.
localization_en-US.scroll_of_energy_desc: Even just holding it makes you feel revitalized. Reading the scroll will restore energy to the entire party.
localization_en-US.scroll_of_energy_trait: Read the scroll to restore #{0}# energy to all party members.
localization_en-US.tome_of_health_desc: Contains a variety of medicinal recipes and practical tips for the aspiring doctor. Medical education not required.
localization_en-US.tome_of_stats_desc: Describes a hundred daily habits to improve the reader's life in almost every way possible.
localization_en-US.tome_of_energy_desc: A collection of honorable legends and inspiring anecdotes. Will encourage even the most melancholic serf.
localization_en-US.mechanical_experiment_desc: In search of new breakthroughs in mechanical science.
localization_en-US.biological_experiment_desc: In search of new breakthroughs in biological studies.
localization_en-US.alchemical_experiment_desc: In search of new breakthroughs in alchemical knowledge.
localization_en-US.prayer_beads_desc: An ornate necklace of blessed gold and silver beads, intended to be used in ritualized prayer.
localization_en-US.blessed_prayer_beads_desc: Having been blessed by a miracle of Saint Ilonia, clerics from all walks of life would be honored to own these beads.
localization_en-US.prayer_1_desc: A cleric offers a devout prayer to Saint Ilonia, generating a small amount of faith for your Kingdom.
localization_en-US.prayer_2_desc: A more powerful prayer that would be more likely to garner Saint Ilonia's favor.
localization_en-US.cherub_desc: A small angelic creature empowered with healing magic.
localization_en-US.valkyrie_desc: A holy angelic warrior who smites her foes with divine fury.
localization_en-US.arbiter_desc: The purest expression of divine punishment. None can escape his sword of wrath.
localization_en-US.indulgence_desc: A document issued by the divine bureaucracy that promises to erase the bearer's sins upon death.
localization_en-US.blessed_arms_desc: Extends a holy blessing over any weapon, increasing its Quality.
localization_en-US.blessed_equipment_desc: Extends a holy blessing over any non-weapon piece of equipment, increasing its Quality.
localization_en-US.pontiff_ring_desc: A coveted signet ring that signifies the wearer's high standing in the Church of Saint Ilonia.
localization_en-US.pontiff_ring_trait: Protects the wearer's allies from a single fatal attack.
localization_en-US.martyr_relic_desc: The bones of a fallen hero, carefully preserved in a gilded wooden locket. Bestows divine protection upon the bearer.
localization_en-US.martyr_relic_trait: Protects the bearer from a single fatal attack.
localization_en-US.divine_protection_desc: Protects the adventurer from a single fatal attack, and restores them to full health. The source of the protection is consumed once triggered.
localization_en-US.fragmented_nightmare_desc: The physical manifestation of Sholrath's nightmare, shattered into pieces by the creature's death throes.
localization_en-US.fragmented_nightmare_locked_desc: Reward is only available when a Nightmare Distiller is active.
localization_en-US.reconstructed_nightmare_desc: A reconstituted essence of pure darkness.
localization_en-US.cleansed_nightmare_desc: The toxic negative energy has been purified by the grace of Saint Ilonia. By Her grace, it can be put to a better use.
localization_en-US.nightmare_casing_desc: A hideously complex mago-tech invention, designed to constrain and direct the concentrated power of nightmare.
localization_en-US.nightmare_collector_desc: The pinnacle of mago-tech engineering, designed to extract the living energy of a dreaming God.
localization_en-US.engrave_jewelry_quality_desc: A simple but delicate engraving of power that gives a small quality boost.
localization_en-US.distilled_nightmare_desc: Subdued fragment of Sholrath's power. Each Distilled Nightmare provides one prestige point during your Reawakening.
localization_en-US.distilled_nightmare_locked_desc: Reward is only available when a Nightmare Distiller is active and fully charged.
localization_en-US.distilled_nightmare_build: #Reward unavailable#\n\nBuild a Nightmare Distiller to continue collecting Distilled Nightmare.
localization_en-US.distilled_nightmare_empty: #Reward unavailable#\n\nNightmare Distiller is not yet at full charge.
localization_en-US.nightmare_distiller_desc: Allows you collect more Distilled Nightmare prestige currency. Requires a steady supply of Nightmare Collectors.
localization_en-US.nightmare_distiller_locked: Requires dungeon progress: Tendril of Sholrath
localization_en-US.nightmare_distiller_tt: A fully charged distiller allows you to collect #Distilled Nightmare# from the remains of the Tendril of Sholrath. These can be spent during #Reawakening# to unlock new perks!
localization_en-US.nightmare_distiller_status_enabled:
Distiller is currently #Enabled#.

While enabled, enemies in the #Ironcrag Siege# and #Tomb of Sholrath# are empowered.

Current danger level:

{0}
localization_en-US.nightmare_distiller_status_disabled: Distiller is currently #Disabled#.\n\nEnemy strength is returned to normal, but Nightmares cannot be collected.
localization_en-US.nightmare_distiller_status_locked: Distiller can't be enabled or disabled while a party is inside the Tomb of Sholrath.
localization_en-US.nightmare_total:
You have gained #{0} Distilled Nightmare!#
Total unspent points: #{1}#.

Dispel the nightmare to reset your game and spend your newfound prestige currency.
localization_en-US.nightmare_defeated:
#The Tendril of Sholrath has been defeated!#

However, the dead god's evil still lingers. Continue playing by building #Nightmare Distillers# and collecting more of the creature's essence, or #Reawaken# to spend your collected nightmares on powerful new upgrades for your next game.

You can reawaken at any time through the menu in the top-left corner.
localization_en-US.prestige_resource_cost_reduce_desc: Reduces the exponential cost increase of resource, forest, and farm upgrades by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.prestige_currency_tax_reduce_desc: Reduces the Currency Exchange tax by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.prestige_equipment_quality_desc: Increases the base quality of crafted equipment by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.prestige_human_quality_desc: Increases the base training of recruited Conscripts and Adventurers by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.prestige_handcrafting_productivity_desc: Items you craft by hand have a base productivity of #+{0}#.
localization_en-US.prestige_dark_essence_quality_desc: The Imbue Dark Essence enchantment grants an additional #+{0}# quality.
localization_en-US.prestige_human_health_desc: Increases maximum health of all your human combatants by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.prestige_sell_value_desc: Increases sell value of items in the Shop and Luxury Shop by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.prestige_hint_tooltip:
Reawakening allows you to spend all collected #Distilled Nightmares# on powerful buffs. In exchange, your game will reset to the beginning.

Most #Utility# tech will carry over to your new save, so you don't have to start entirely from scratch.

An #Autosave# will be created as you click this button, so you can always return here if you change your mind.
localization_en-US.cr_descriptor: Teaches you how to craft this item.
localization_en-US.engrave_heavy_armor_health_desc: Engrave a piece of heavy armor to provide a minor Health bonus.
localization_en-US.engrave_light_armor_health_desc: Embroider a piece of light or medium armor to provide a minor Health bonus.
localization_en-US.engrave_heavy_armor_armor_desc: Engrave a piece of heavy armor to provide additional Armor.
localization_en-US.engrave_light_armor_armor_desc: Embroider a piece of light or medium armor to provide additional Armor.
localization_en-US.engrave_light_armor_dex_desc: Embroider a piece of light or medium armor to provide additional Dexterity.
localization_en-US.engrave_light_armor_mag_desc: Embroider a piece of light or medium armor to provide additional Magic.
localization_en-US.engrave_light_armor_wis_desc: Embroider a piece of light or medium armor to provide additional Wisdom.
localization_en-US.engrave_weapon_str_desc: Engrave any weapon to provide additional Strength.
localization_en-US.engrave_weapon_dex_desc: Engrave any weapon to provide additional Dexterity.
localization_en-US.engrave_weapon_mag_desc: Engrave any weapon to provide additional Magic.
localization_en-US.engrave_weapon_wis_desc: Engrave any weapon to provide additional Wisdom.
localization_en-US.enchant_food_quality_desc: Enchants any food with a powerful spell that improves its taste. Quality is increased as a side effect.
localization_en-US.enchant_weapon_power_desc: Enchants an weapon to provide additional Combat Power.
localization_en-US.enchant_armor_energy_desc: Enchants any piece of Head or Chest armor to provide additional Energy.
localization_en-US.enchant_armor_stats_desc: Enchants any piece of Head or Chest armor to provide boosts to all primary stats.
localization_en-US.enchant_item_quality_desc: Weaves a powerful Dark Essence into any piece of equipment to significantly increase its quality.
localization_en-US.supply_wood_plank_desc: Provides a steady supply of Wood Plank from your Supply Depot.
localization_en-US.supply_linen_cloth_desc: Provides a steady supply of Linen Cloth from your Supply Depot.
localization_en-US.supply_rough_leather_desc: Provides a steady supply of Rough Leather from your Supply Depot.
localization_en-US.mine_iron_ore_desc: Provides a steady supply of Iron Ore from your Mine.
localization_en-US.mine_sapphire_desc: A rich vein of gemstones provides a steady supply of Sapphires.
localization_en-US.mine_gold_ore_desc: Your miners have discovered a mineral vein rich in Gold Ore.
localization_en-US.mine_silver_ore_desc: A large deposit deep underground provides a steady supply of Silver Ore.
localization_en-US.tech_deco_desc: Unlocks the ability to place colored background boxes to organize your workflow.
localization_en-US.deco_rect_desc: Colored background element for workflow organization.
localization_en-US.deco_label_desc: Attach a name to parts of your workflow to remind yourself of their purpose.
localization_en-US.deco_sticker_desc: Further improve and organize your layout by attaching icons to remind you of their function.
localization_en-US.easy_node_upgrade_desc: #Control-click# an empty node upgrade slot to automatically purchase the most relevant upgrade.
localization_en-US.buy_menu_search_desc: Adds a search field to the Build Menu, to search for available nodes by name.
localization_en-US.unlock_picker_desc: #[Q]# or #[Middle-click]# to copy a node and all of its settings.
localization_en-US.unlock_area_move_desc: Unlocks the ability to select, move and deconstruct any number of nodes at once.
localization_en-US.clone_tool_desc: Press #[C]# to select and copy parts of your workflow.
localization_en-US.container_clone_desc: #[Q]# or #[Middle-click]# to copy a Container and everything anchored to it.
localization_en-US.forest_wood_log_desc: Teaches your Lumberjacks to cut down trees and supply Wood Logs.
localization_en-US.forest_wolf_hide_desc: Teaches your Hunters to hunt ferocious wolves and supply Wolf Hide.
localization_en-US.forest_bird_egg_desc: Teaches your Foragers how to spot camouflaged nests and supply Small Bird Eggs.
localization_en-US.forest_resin_desc: Teaches your Lumberjacks to extract Resin from pine trees.
localization_en-US.forest_bone_desc: Teaches your Hunters to identify and extract powerful Bones.
localization_en-US.forest_mushroom_desc: Teaches your Foragers how to identify and collect edible Mushrooms.
localization_en-US.forest_lettuce_desc: Teaches your Foragers how to identify and harvest wild Lettuce.
localization_en-US.forest_boar_meat_desc: Teaches your Hunters how to track and kill wild boars without being gored.
localization_en-US.forest_ancient_wood_desc: Teaches your Lumberjacks to identify and dismember the largest trees in the forest for Ancient Wood Logs.
localization_en-US.forest_supple_leather_desc: Teaches your Hunters to track and dispatch the nimble stalkers that can be harvested for Supple Leather.
localization_en-US.forest_wild_onion_desc: Teaches your Foragers how to identify and harvest wild Onions.
localization_en-US.outfitter_2_desc: Unlocks the Food equipment slot for the Outfitter.
localization_en-US.outfitter_timeout_desc: Allows you to set up a timeout to allow adventurers to pass through if no equipment is available.
localization_en-US.outfitter_skip_replace_desc: Adventurers can now replace their existing equipment at the Outfitter. If an item of the exact same type is supplied, the Outfitter is skipped instead.
localization_en-US.outfitter_automation_desc: Outfitters no longer require your input to function.
localization_en-US.turtle_statue_desc: An ancient monument, preserved through time. Perhaps a forgotten deity was worshipped here?
localization_en-US.war_effort_passive_desc: Inserting any soldier into a War Effort has a #5%# chance of immediately granting a Medal.
localization_en-US.war_effort_forest_desc: Unlocks the war to liberate Byrgenwald Forest and the village of Yensmouth from the despicable Southside Brigands.
localization_en-US.req_passive_desc: Passively generates one free Requisition every #{0}# seconds.
localization_en-US.artisan_desc: Increases Quality of produced items by up to #{0}#.
localization_en-US.crafting_overseer_desc: Increases Productivity by #{0}#. Effect is #halved# for equippable items.
localization_en-US.enhance_overseer_desc: Increases Productivity by #{0}#. Productivity does not affect item enhancements.
localization_en-US.resource_artisan_desc: Increases Quality of produced items by up to #{0}#, but also adds an additional cost per item.
localization_en-US.recruit_artisan_desc: Increases Quality of recruited humans by up to #{0}#, but also adds an additional cost per recruit.
localization_en-US.crafting_artisan_desc: Increases Quality of produced items by up to #{0}#, but also adds an additional crafting fee.
localization_en-US.training_artisan_desc: Increases Training gained by #{0}#, but also reduces training speed by #{1}#.
localization_en-US.cashier_desc: Increases the sell value of items by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.req_cashier_desc: Increases the amount of Requisition earned by #{0}#.
localization_en-US.overseer_tech_desc: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your {0}.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #{1}#.
localization_en-US.crafting_overseer_tech_desc: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your {0}.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #{1}#. Effect is #halved# for equippable items.
localization_en-US.enhance_overseer_tech_desc: Unlocks the #Overseer# upgrade for your {0}.\n\nIncreases Productivity by #{1}#. Productivity does not affect item enhancements.
localization_en-US.tutorial_productivity_desc: #Productivity# slowly builds up over time as items are crafted. When the producivity bar is full, a free item is created.
localization_en-US.automation_2_desc: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your {0}.\n\nAdding more #Workers# increases production speed.
localization_en-US.automation_slot_desc: Unlocks an additional #Upgrade slot# for your {0}.
localization_en-US.tutorial_quality_desc: #Quality# increases stats and value of an item. Crafting with high quality materials also causes the result to increase in quality.
localization_en-US.general_quality_desc: Unlocks the #Artisan# upgrade to increase the quality of produced items.
localization_en-US.resource_quality_desc: Unlocks the #Purveyor# upgrade to increase the quality of supplied items, at an additional cost per item.
localization_en-US.mine_quality_desc: Unlocks the #Prospector# upgrade to increase the quality of mined items, at an additional cost per item.

localization_en-US.StatEnergyDesc: Almost all activities consume energy. When an adventurer runs out of energy, they will retire and will no longer be available for you to command.\n\n#Note:# Completing the same kind of activity more than once will drain an increased amount of energy.

localization_en-US.CurrencyGoldDesc: Gold, silver and copper coins minted in the Central Empire. Legal tender in most of the known world, though forgeries and debased coins are common.\n\nSource: #Shop#
localization_en-US.CurrencyRequisitionDesc: Bearer bonds that certify your public service to the city of Yensburg. Required currency to deal with many of the city's guilds.\n\nSource: #Requisition Office#
localization_en-US.CurrencyMedalDesc: Awarded to soldiers for their valiance in battle against the enemies of Yensburg. A copy of the medal certificate is provided to you as proof of services rendered.\n\nSource: #War Effort#
localization_en-US.CurrencyRingDesc: A wearable silver token used by the Adventurer's Guild. In case of an adventurer's death, their rings can be used to pay for their funeral.\n\nSource: #Quest Board#
localization_en-US.CurrencyManaDesc: Unbound magical energy, ready to be used in the creation of magical items or the furthering of arcane research.\n\nSource: #Disenchanter#, #Quest Board#
localization_en-US.CurrencyCrownDesc: Tokens of appreciation from the former King of Yensburg, used primarily by the upper echelons of society.\n\nSource: #Restaurant#, #Luxury Shop#
localization_en-US.CurrencyDucatDesc: Ancient coins from a long-dead Empire. Prized for both their symbolical value and high gold content.\n\nSource: #Dungeon#, #Mercenary Guild#
localization_en-US.CurrencyIngenuityDesc: A representation of scientific progress in your kingdom. One crazy invention leads to another.\n\nSource: #Inventor#, #Library#
localization_en-US.CurrencyFaithDesc: Your citizens' worship of their guardian deity provides tangible benefits to your kingdom.\n\nSource: #Shrine#, #Graveyard#
localization_en-US.war_common_stage_1_desc: The former capital of a once great kingdom, now besieged on all sides by enemies hellbent on the city's destruction. \n\nThe city's defenses are holding, but it is getting increasingly difficult to resupply.
localization_en-US.war_common_tutorial: Build a #War Effort# node and supply it with well-equipped #Conscripts# to start pushing back the enemy. Earn #Medals# for engaging in combat, and liberate the points of interest held by the enemy for an additional passive reward!
localization_en-US.war_forest_desc: A ragtag band of assorted criminals, brought together by a common cause: Plunder. They have occupied most of the ancient forest of Byrgenwald south of the city, cutting off contact with the forest dwellers and the port town of Yensmouth beyond.
localization_en-US.war_forest_stage_1_desc: The ancient forest of Byrgenwald has supplied Yensburg for many generations. Its massive trees provide the highest quality lumber, and the hunters that predate on the forest's many animals feed the hungry mouths in the city.
localization_en-US.war_forest_stage_1_reward: Retake the forest to unlock the Forest tech!
localization_en-US.war_forest_stage_2_desc: The austere scholars of the College have studied the applied sciences for decades. Within their hallowed library lie secrets that would enable the craftsmen of Yensburg to produce higher quality items.
localization_en-US.war_forest_stage_2_reward: Retake the college to unlock Quality upgrades!
localization_en-US.war_forest_stage_3_desc: Many of the forest's most ferocious creatures live in the massive cave network known as the Feral Den. Rumor has it that a mysterious alpha monster leads the feral animals from deep within the Den.
localization_en-US.war_forest_stage_3_reward: Unlock additional hunting and foraging options!
localization_en-US.war_forest_stage_4_desc: The famous port town of Yensmouth was once the home of the kingdom's Adventurer's Guild. However, with access cut off by the Southside Brigands, it has languished in obscurity for years.
localization_en-US.war_forest_stage_4_reward: Retake Yensmouth to begin restoring the Adventurer's Guild!
localization_en-US.war_east_desc: A brutish force that invaded Yensburg's territory from the east. Under their occupation, Yensburg is cut off from the fertile eastern lands, as well as the enormous fortress-city of Bastion.
localization_en-US.war_east_stage_1_desc: The former heartland of Yensburg's territory, with prime farmland crissccrossed by gentle streams. In better times the area provided a bounty of food to the population of Yensburg.
localization_en-US.war_east_stage_1_reward: Retake the farmstead to unlock the Farm tech!
localization_en-US.war_east_stage_2_desc: In ancient times these ruins were home to a large fortress, treasury, and prison complex. As the territory of Yensburg expanded the location was abandoned, and eventually overtaken by forces with nefarious intent.
localization_en-US.war_east_stage_2_reward: Retake the ruins to begin your descent into the Dungeon!
localization_en-US.war_east_stage_3_desc: For centuries, this dry gorge formed the eastern border of Yensburg's territory, a natural barrier separating it from the Hinterlands beyond. These days, the fortress at Terminus is deserted, save for a mad hermit that has managed to keep the orcs at bay.
localization_en-US.war_east_stage_3_reward: Retake the gorge to unlock the Summoning Circle tech!
localization_en-US.war_east_stage_4_desc: The fortress-city of Bastion was founded after the first expedition into the Hinterlands, centuries ago. The surrounding territory was subsequently conquered by orcs, but the city still defiantly maintains a human population.
localization_en-US.war_east_stage_4_reward: Retake Bastion to regain access to its Arena!
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_desc: A hidden army has struck at the heart of Yensburg, pouring from the catacombs below the city and establishing control over the wealthy northern districts.
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_stage_1_desc: The world-renowned crafters in Artisan Row have brought business to Yensburg for generations. Now, their workshops supply weapons and armor for the enemy.
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_stage_1_reward: Retake Artisan Row to unlock the Inventor tech!
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_stage_2_desc: Saint Ilonia, the Shepherd of Dreams, is the revered figure at the center of Yensburg's religion. Recapture her cathedral before it is defiled by the enemy.
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_stage_2_reward: Retake the Cathedral to unlock the Shrine tech!
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_stage_3_desc: The wealthy Castle District is home to Yensburg's nobility, with the former king's grand castle at its center. Evidence shows that the enemy infiltrated the city from this place.
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_stage_3_reward: Retake the Castle District to unlock the Yensburg Catacombs dungeon!
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_stage_4_desc: At the heart of the castle lies the throne room, a shining beacon of Yensburg's authority. The enemy has barricaded themselves there, clearly engaged in some sinister plot.
localization_en-US.war_yensburg_stage_4_reward: Retake the Throne Room to be crowned King, and begin your assault on the enemy stronghold!
localization_en-US.war_north_desc: A hidden army has struck at the heart of Yensburg, pouring from the catacombs below the city and establishing control over the wealthy northern districts.
localization_en-US.war_north_stage_1_desc: A vast mansion in the fields north of Yensburg that was once home to the Adventurer's Guild. For decades, it has been the home base of the treacherous Black Banner Legion mercenary band.
localization_en-US.war_north_stage_2_desc: One of the few passable routes that lead further north, into the mountains. The natural chokepoint has been the end of several military campaigns in the past.
localization_en-US.war_north_stage_3_desc: As your army crests the mountain, they are shocked to discover its volcanic caldera. Lava spews forth from the earth and sinks back down in an endless churning lake of fire.
localization_en-US.war_north_stage_4_desc: At the top of the mountain, a hidden path leads past the caldera and down into the earth. The enemy's stronghold has been exposed.
localization_en-US.war_north_stage_4_reward: Conquer the Pinnacle Ruins in order to descend into the Tomb of Sholrath.
localization_en-US.war_north_stage_4_reward_2: The path to the Tomb has been breached!

Training improves stats and passive buffs, and may bestow #class specialization# if all prerequisites are met.

Most adventurer activities expend #energy#.

localization_en-US.quest_common_tutorial:
Complete #Quests# for the inhabitants of Yensburg to earn rewards. All quests are repeatable, but rewards may decrease after the first completion.

Adventurers quickly grow tired of quests, looking for bigger challenges. #Energy drain# is increased significantly if an Adventurer is sent back to complete more quests.

Each #Quest Board# can dispatch up to five adventurers at once.
localization_en-US.patrol_market_desc: The market square in Yensburg is visited by thousands every week - and crime is rife. Help out the city guard by patrolling the market for pickpockets and other petty criminals.
localization_en-US.exterminate_rats_desc: Enormous invasive rats have been spotted in the harbor, possibly introduced from overseas. Several people have been found dead, gnawed to the bone. Exterminate the rats before they can establish a foothold!
localization_en-US.dispel_library_desc: The Grand Library of Yensburg has been overtaken by enchanted books. Dispel the ancient magic that animates the books and reclaim access to the library.
localization_en-US.clear_mines_desc: The network of mine tunnels that supply most of Yensburg's raw iron ore have been overrun by kobolds, causing significant supply bottlenecks. Clear out the vermin and restore access to a greater stockpile of iron.
localization_en-US.bank_heist_desc: The Central Bank of Yensburg holds a vast number of gold and silver bars that technically belong to you, but withdrawing them would mean years of paperwork. Thankfully, there's an easier way of getting your hands on them.
localization_en-US.forest_evangelism_desc: The rugged inhabitants of Byrgenwald Forest would be a great addition to Yensburg's workforce. Send out emissaries to proselytize to them and convince them of their new purpose.
localization_en-US.mercurial_reagents_desc: Your enchanters have petitioned for a greater supply of Mercurial Flux. With it, they will be able to aid in the crafting of powerful Arcanite equipment. Unfortunately, this rare catalyst can only be found deep inside a claustrophobic cave network.
localization_en-US.shield_innocent_desc: The brewing war in the East has displaced many people, driving them towards Yensburg while being chased by marauding orcs. Defend the fleeing refugees and make sure they are safe from harm.
localization_en-US.farmstead_liberator_desc: Gangs of orcs and other marauders have occupied much of the farmland that surrounds Yensburg, enslaving the farmers and exporting the produce back to their homeland. Eradicate these squatters from your lands.
localization_en-US.byrgenwald_expedition_desc: The vast woods south of Yensburg have never been fully safe, but recently even travel over the Imperial Road has been fraught with danger. Drive off the wild creatures that threaten passage through the forest.
localization_en-US.elemental_eradication_desc: For generations, the elementals of Midlake have lived in relatively harmony with the surrounding human settlements. Their recent unprovoked aggression calls for them to be culled once and for all.
localization_en-US.experimental_summons_desc: The cult that runs your Summoning Circle calls for help with some of their more obscure rituals. Specifically, they need a bodyguard to protect them in case the result of their summoning proves to be hard to control.
localization_en-US.extinguish_ritual_desc: Spies in Yensburg have discovered a network of occult rituals being carried out in the dark places of the city. Send in someone with knowledge of the occult to put a stop to these blasphemous practices.
localization_en-US.aid_refugees_desc: As refugees were driven westward towards Yensburg, they ended up in a refugee camp that has been set up in the city's slums. Send in a team that has experience in dealing with the disease and misery that reign there.
localization_en-US.UIQuestDifficultyDesc: Recommended Combat Power for your adventurers (before modifiers from Challenges). \n\nHaving higher Combat Power will make quests easier and faster to complete; insufficient Combat Power may cause your adventurers to struggle significantly, suffer exhaustion, or even die.
localization_en-US.UIDungeonDifficultyDesc: Recommended total Combat Power for the entire party.\n\nHaving higher Combat Power will make completing the dungeon easier and faster; significantly lower Combat Power is likely to result in failure.

localization_en-US.quest_challenge_increase_duration_desc: Quest duration increases for each time this quest has been completed previously.

localization_en-US.quest_challenge_tank_shadow_dmg_desc: Deals heavy #Shadow# damage to the tank.
localization_en-US.quest_challenge_acid_rain_desc: Deals minor damage to the entire party.
localization_en-US.quest_challenge_clear_rubble_desc: Drains energy from all party members unless any adventurer succeeds on a #Strength# check.
