localization_en-US.dungeon_ruins_desc: The remnants of an ancient treasure vault, repurposed into a high-security prison after the flow of valuables from the east dried up. \n\nScouting reports indicate that the surface is crawling with orcs, while the lower levels are controlled by the shambling remains of former inmates.
localization_en-US.ruins_1_trash_desc: The once-grand main hall of the vault complex, now ruined by the passage of time and used as living quarters by an army of orcs.
localization_en-US.ruins_1_boss_desc: An elder orc warlock that leads his own warband. Intrigued by the ruins of Yensburg's past, he has been trying to break through into the deep vaults beneath the prison.
localization_en-US.ruins_2_trash_desc: The orcs were unable to venture past the main hall, leaving the Armory mostly untouched. The ghostly remains of the former guards have defended this place for centuries.
localization_en-US.ruins_2_boss_desc: A spectral warrior of grand renown. Under his instruction the guardians of Arlingen have prevented outsiders from interfering, and they've kept the deranged inmates contained in the lower reaches.
localization_en-US.ruins_3_trash_desc: These cells were once home to the most dangerous people that ever plagued the lands of Yensburg. The potent magical wards in this place have kept their souls imprisoned here ever since.
localization_en-US.ruins_3_boss_desc: Marlowe was once the captain of a despicable band of pirates that looted and pillaged their way along the coast, sparing none. After his imprisonment he continued his career and established himself as a merciless gang leader.
localization_en-US.ruins_4_trash_desc: Aside from the human inmates, Arlington Fortress also held some more exotic prisoners. Several exotic creatures were imprisoned here, under the impression that killing them might be more hazardous than keeping them alive.
localization_en-US.ruins_4_boss_desc: An ancient Watcher, a prophetic creature that can see into the past and future simultaneously. It once predicted the death of the royal family, then killed them all personally to fulfill its mad prophecy.
localization_en-US.dungeon_feral_desc: The vast network of caves known as the Feral Den lies deep beneath the roots of Byrgenwald Forest. Its wild denizens rarely interact with the surface world.\n\nRecent reports show that a strange corruption is seeping from deep within the cave, driving the beasts upwards towards the surface, driven mad with rage.
localization_en-US.feral_1_trash_desc: The critters that inhabit the land surrounding the entrance to the Feral Den have been driven mad with corruption. Even reaching the den itself is now fraught with peril.
localization_en-US.feral_1_boss_desc: The remnants of a once-revered treant that has been hit especially hard by the corruption. Its branches creak as its trunk slowly rots and withers away.
localization_en-US.feral_2_trash_desc: Animals that still hunt on the surface have historically taken refuge in the upper reaches of the Den. Now, in their mad rage, they lash out at anything they see as a threat to their territory.
localization_en-US.feral_2_boss_desc: An enormous bear-creature stands guard at the entrance to a deeper cavern. A miasma of corruption lingers around its lair.
localization_en-US.feral_3_trash_desc: A gargantuan underground lake and associated biosphere. Its once-pristine waters have been tainted by something seeping in from deep within the earth.
localization_en-US.feral_3_boss_desc: A monstrous rat-creature that appears to have been a test subject for the development of novel toxins. Its flesh bears the scars of both gruesome experimentation and focused magical healing.
localization_en-US.feral_4_trash_desc: Driven underground by the encroaching humans, the diminutive ratlings have dug their burrows in the deepest reaches of the Feral Den, swearing to one day exact revenge on the surface dwellers.
localization_en-US.feral_4_boss_desc: The evil mastermind behind the plan to poison the ancient forest on the surface. He was driven mad by his thirst for revenge, eventually developing the potent toxin that destroyed the ratlings' new home as well.
localization_en-US.temple_1_trash_desc: The scorching desert sun has kept the Temple safe from most prying eyes. The surface ruins are only inhabited by a scattering of desert creatures.
localization_en-US.temple_1_boss_desc: A giant scorpoid that has been the subject of many tall tales in Bastion. Apparently the creature is very real, and very willing to defend its territory.
localization_en-US.temple_2_trash_desc: A massive stone structure sits at the center of the temple complex. The desert beasts keep their distance from the pyramid, as the area is guarded by animated stone golems.
localization_en-US.temple_2_boss_desc: A massive golem that guards the entrance to the temple's inner sanctum. It will stop at nothing to defend this holy place from tomb raiders.
localization_en-US.temple_3_trash_desc: After the ritual was completed all of the attending priests were ceremoniously sacrificed and mummified, their remains bound to defend this place from intruders for all eternity.
localization_en-US.temple_3_boss_desc: The leader of the ritualists was the last one to be willingly sacrificed at the conclusion of their ritual. Brought back to life by necromantic magic, he speaks only five words: Sholrath must not be awoken.
localization_en-US.temple_4_trash_desc: Even a thousand years later this room still bears the scars of the profane ritual that was carried out here. Ancient spirits that were tethered here by the complex incantations lash out at anyone that approaches.
localization_en-US.temple_4_boss_desc: An ancient human bound to the Lord of Nightmares in eternal servitude. After centuries of fruitless effort, they are now close to unraveling the magical incantations that bind their master in deep sleep.
localization_en-US.catacombs_1_trash_desc: The ancient sewers of Yensburg lie just beneath the city streets. Vermin has been left to multiply here undisturbed, and the recent demonic incursion has empowered them beyond any mortal comprehension.
localization_en-US.catacombs_1_boss_desc: An ancient and wise wizard who lived among the vermin for decades, orchestrating their swarms and employing them for espionage. The demonic corruption has rendered him beyond help, and he must be slain.
localization_en-US.catacombs_2_trash_desc: The entrance to the ancient Catacombs is littered with the bones considered unworthy of being interred into the catacombs proper. Demonic magic now animates their remains.
localization_en-US.catacombs_2_boss_desc: The skeletal remains of the dead rise up from the alcoves, and are haphazardly bound together into a single monstrous creature with necromantic magic.
localization_en-US.catacombs_3_trash_desc: Burial grounds of the early explorers who founded Yensburg. Their remains were interred deep underground to protect the holy remains of their beloved Saint. Now, demons roam the halls.
localization_en-US.catacombs_3_boss_desc: A massive hellish creature guards the broken doors to the inner sanctum. Scorching heat burns anyone that dares to approach the monster.
localization_en-US.catacombs_4_trash_desc: The sacred halls dedicated to the Saint appear to be the origin of the demonic invasion. Something down here must have created a portal and allowed their incursion into our world.
localization_en-US.catacombs_4_boss_desc: Powerful champion of the Black Banner Legion, a mercenary warband that has been suspected of treason in the past. Now, their intentions are clear: They seek the downfall of Yensburg and all of its citizens.
localization_en-US.archive_1_trash_desc: An illusory cliff conceals a hidden valley, behind which lies a massive stone vault door. Mind-controlled servants attempt to dissuade you from pressing on.
localization_en-US.archive_1_boss_desc: A powerful dwarven warrior, a race rarely seen in Yensburg. His extensive battle scars hint at his ancient nature.
localization_en-US.archive_2_trash_desc: The massive library complex is stocked with books in every conceivable language, many of which haven't been spoken for hundreds of years. The endless legion of researchers barely notices your presence.
localization_en-US.archive_2_boss_desc: A hulking wizard that guards the library's contents and workforce. Try to take a book, and you'll have to deal with him. Legends say he has read every book on physical training ever published in the entire universe.
localization_en-US.archive_3_trash_desc: A dank and dysmal prison complex that was intended to hold the Archive's bestiary of living creatures. However, after a series of escapes, the area was boarded up and abandoned.
localization_en-US.archive_3_boss_desc: A majestic green drake that broke out of his confinement a long time ago. While freed from his cell, he still found himself unable to leave the prison complex, and slowly went mad over time.
localization_en-US.archive_4_trash_desc: Private rooms and winding hallways hidden deep underground that contain the Archive's most prized possessions. Many of the samples collected here are one-of-a-kind items, though their purpose may be unknown.
localization_en-US.archive_4_boss_desc: An ancient lich lord, driven mad with power and thirst for knowledge. Having shed most of her original form, she now exists only as a pale skeleton dressed in tattered robes. Don't underestimate her ancient sorcery.
localization_en-US.endgame_1_trash_desc: The caldera of Ironcrag is filled with an ever-bubbling pool of lava. The searing heat alone should be enough to keep out unwanted intruders, but there's also the fire-loving creatures that seek out this place.
localization_en-US.endgame_1_boss_desc: High Prince of the fire elementals. The mountain's increased volcanic activity drew him to this place, and he now guards the entrance to the Tomb's interior.
localization_en-US.endgame_2_trash_desc: In ages past, when Sholrath was first sealed away, these halls saw a hundred sacrifices carried out daily. The remains of the victims were carried off by the lava, while their spirits still linger.
localization_en-US.endgame_2_boss_desc: In accordance with the ancient rites, one single priest was left alive after the ritual was completed. His soul was tethered to this place, fated to ward off intruders for all eternity.
localization_en-US.endgame_3_trash_desc: An enormous underground cavern opens up, revealing a large fortress made of pitch-black stone and lit by flowing lava. If this was a movie, it would be the villain's lair.
localization_en-US.endgame_3_boss_desc: Hushed whispers allude to the fact that this ancient creature was in fact once human, a witch who so thoroughly abandoned her humanity that she sought to overthrow life itself and reawaken an ancient evil.
localization_en-US.endgame_4_trash_desc: Thousands of arcane crystals stud the walls, aligned and arranged in intricate unknowable patterns. Somehow, this place is keeping the physical manifestation of Sholrath trapped in its own dream.
localization_en-US.endgame_4_boss_desc: A tiny, insignificant fragment of the ancient evil threatening your kingdom. Strike down the beast, even just a small fragment of it, and show it that you will not lie down and surrender.
localization_en-US.OutfitterIntroCTA: Input a human in the top slot and an equippable item in the bottom slot to combine them. \n\nEach Outfitter can equip only a single item, but multiple outfitters can be chained together to equip a full set of weapons and armor.
